newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas offers move higher, only two deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas offers move higher, only two deals done.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were bid and offered in a reasonably tight range across all periods on Friday morning as two trades were done for a total of 30 lots.
September traded 25 lots at 9.90 pence a therm, down by 0.05 pence from Thursday's settlement, while January traded five lots at 18.00 pence, up by 0.05 pence.
Although September saw a price fall, several months showed signals that the market was strong.

Bids in August, November, December, February and March were at or above the previous settlement levels, and the offers in these periods were higher still. Offers in every month but September were up on the previous settlement level.

At the close of the morning session, the first quarter was quoted in a spread of 16.62/16.90 pence a therm, compared with a closing assessment of 16.70/16.75 pence on the OTC market on Thursday evening.
Futures showed a bid/offer spread for Q4 of 13.07/13.34 pence, up from 13.05/13.15 pence on the OTC market's closing level on Thursday.
Although the volume of trade was thin on Friday morning, the week as a whole has been one of the busiest since the early days of the contract, launched at the end of January.
